reviews.text: The services may be very expensive, but they saved my cats. Dr. Kelly and Dr. Abraham are wonderful people. Despite my limited resources, they gave me more affordable options and supported me every step of the way. Words cannot express my gratitude. This hospital is excellent.
Excellent service, and very professional in pet care
Excellent service, all the veterinarians are highly recommended!

I wanted to share my experience in case it helps someone else. I took my bunny to the emergency vet because his stomach was extremely swollen and hard. (It was the only place that could see him on a Sunday at 11 pm). He wouldn't eat and he wasn't moving. They examined him and took x-rays, but their conclusion was based more on what we told them than on what they saw in the x-rays. They said they had to hospitalize him and keep him under observation, without being very clear about what the next steps would be. They just said he "would be under observation." The truth is, the hospitalization costs (I think it was for 2 or 3 days) and the additional costs (which they also add to the bill) were way out of our reach. It was more than 10,000 pesos, and we had to pay a deposit, with no guarantee that my bunny would survive.

We decided to take him to another vet for a second opinion. They made me sign a form taking responsibility if he died or something happened because they couldn't hospitalize him. I had to ask them myself if there was any medication or anything they could give him to reduce the pain and inflammation in the meantime (they insisted on hospitalization). Thankfully, I finally got the medication the next day, and my bunny responded well; he gradually started to improve.
My impression was that they insist on hospitalizing your pet, no matter what, without giving you much of an alternative. They even made comments that I perceived as quite pessimistic, trying to pressure you into saying yes. Always ask if there are any other options or medications they can give him and explore other possibilities.

The doctors give you peace of mind and confidence regarding the treatment.
I arrived in the early hours of the morning and they were incredibly understanding.
I'm not giving it 5 stars because the cost of the tests is a bit high.
Very friendly staff, Dr. Sara is very professional.
The service at Cat Specialists is incredible; they are highly trained professionals, and their treatment of both humans and cats is impeccable. Thank you for taking care of our little ones.

The place is very clean and the service is excellent. Last year our bunny stopped eating and we came in an emergency. He recovered thanks to the quick attention and treatment. Today, a year later, I'm just coming for a check-up and examination. 😉
